name: Illustrations
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Create a production sprite sheet, 3 columns x 2 rows, each equal-size cell has a centered isolated monochrome ink pixel-art spot illustration on the exact same solid pale cream field. No panels, no borders, no cast shadows beyond the object, no shading of the background, no letters, text or digits. Art is cinematic utilitarian Japanese and Korean enamel travel-stamp illustration, elegant woodcut pixel hatching. Top-left: tired young adult Ian at a small writing desk with papers and one metal lamp. Top-middle: a battered open canvas shoulder bag and a pair of headphones. Top-right: a brick bank counter with a small mountain of stamped envelopes. Bottom-left: portable cassette radio and headphones on a folding table. Bottom-middle: apartment buildings, telephone poles, a bus stop at dusk as a wide silhouette. Bottom-right: two enamel mechanical switches and a notched control knob. Strong readable iconography, sophisticated details, TWO INKS ONLY on cream, no UI in this sheet.
